input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Section 19.1 gives an untimed professional/workmanlike warranty and an untimed conformance warranty for Services (which include the hosted software) and Deliverables, and § 19.4 supplies repair/replace/re-perform plus a refund of Fees paid, so the remedy and Services-duration elements are satisfied. However, § 19.2 caps the Deliverable/software conformance warranty at fifteen days and expressly extinguishes any correction or refund obligation after that date, which is below the 90-day fallback floor and is therefore a material deviation. We have made the single minimal change of extending that period to ninety days, bringing the clause to the fallback position; the narrower "intentionally introduced by Vendor" qualifier on the malicious-code warranty in § 19.3 is a preferred-level point we note but do not redline.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
mappings.quote: Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form. Vendor further warrants that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications.

mappings.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge.
Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.

proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty period in § 19.2 from fifteen days to ninety days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our warranty position requires at least a 90-day conformance warranty for software and deliverables, so we have extended the § 19.2 period from fifteen days to ninety days; the existing § 19.1 warranties and the § 19.4 repair/replace and refund remedies are unchanged.
